title: Has A
statement: Implement `solve(sentences)`. Each sentence is `child is-a parent` or `whole has-a part`. Return a list of `is-a` or `has-a` in order. A sentence that matches neither returns `unknown` for that item.
constraints: Do not infer from the nouns
hints: Split on spaces. The tests use exactly three words.
The middle word is the relation.
editorial: is-a is inheritance. has-a is composition. The nouns do not decide it: a Car has an Engine, and an ElectricCar is a Car. Reading the verb is the classification. Guessing from the first noun is how a design discussion gets muddy.
